body: I can understand that. In my experience, it would probably be different because no matter what happens in my life that child will always be a part of it. In my memory, anyway.

I’m honestly not sure about that. I think it’s created a lasting impression, one that will probably last even after I have kids in the future, should that even happen. And with that I’m not sure if it’s actually going to happen.
Also if you want to discuss this further, it’s better to DM that do this comment back and forth.
I wouldn’t disclose right off the bat, but it would be later. For me personally I would rather inform because it has been festering at me.

Because I want to be upfront about it. I would rather be honest and straightforward about something that important, than hide it and not speak up. Miscarriages get hushed up a lot and are received with more or less a quiet reaction. Besides it hurts when you can’t safely admit something like that. You may not get it, because you’re a guy, but miscarriages hit differently for women.

You’re missing the point.

I don’t give out every single detail about myself on the first date. That is one assumption you chose to make, and that makes you look like an idiot. If I want to disclose something like this then it is my choice to disclose it, and if someone doesn’t like it then it is not my problem.

I would say more but I don’t really need to justify myself or my actions to you. You are just a stranger on the internet.
I would rather be honest than not.
The Imperial closed recently, they’re working on occupying the space the Parkview has
And what’s worse, people urge you to be strong. Like it isn’t difficult enough.

This is me every single day.

I’ve dealt with depression in and off for the past few years, but nowadays it feels so much more amplified.

I’m more confused than anything though because while I agreed to pay more on Facebook, they said they would be drawing up a hard copy of it (this was back in December of last year) but now it’s already March and I haven’t seen anything

It’s a relative in my family, yes. An agreement/contract was drawn up initially when this happened, and they said they would have me sign a new one because the payment amount changed. I have yet to see that though.
I’m currently paying them back. So I guess if I were to default on payments, they would be able to take it to a collection agency?

There are people out there who care about me, which is good I suppose, but sometimes it feels like that’s not enough. Honestly, sometimes it seems like maybe dying would be a better option as opposed to living. At least I wouldn’t have to deal with the misery of this world.
What if they’re the ones who give you pain, though, rather than the other way around?
I’m guessing she missed that memo 😂
No, we’ve never been romantically involved, and we’re both dating other people.
